text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho has arrived, and Tokyo Racecourse is full of people cheering even before the race begins.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Squeee! You can do it, Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Show us your stuff, Tamamo Cross! Crush the Beast and get yourself another win!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Here at today's Tenno Sho, Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross will be facing off in an ultimate showdown for the top.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I knew it was going to be a big event, but seeing it in person, the crowd's even more fired up than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross, known as the White Lightning, comes from a poor family. She puts everything on the track for her family's sake.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Her hard work's paid off, and she's won consecutive graded races with record times. She's been leaving a huge impact on people and is still charging ahead with great momentum.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Then there's Oguri Cap, a huge star who started out in regional races before hurtling onto the central racing scene like a meteor.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: She's in her classic year like me, but… To be honest, she's a lot more popular than I am.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The hype is proof of how extraordinary she's already proven herself to be in her races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Anyway, that's everything I learned from my research!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Everyone here is so strong…
choice_data_list: But that doesn't mean you'll lose.
But that doesn't mean you'll lose.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Right. I can't lose.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I won't let anyone take this race from me. After all, I said I would run this with all my strength.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I have to win this so I'll be a worthy rival to Maruzen.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …Here I am at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Ogurin, you can do this! This is where your legend starts!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Show 'em who's boss around here, Tamamo! Give everyone a taste of that Naniwa spirit!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: The spotlight's all on them now—as it should be. There's no place for me to squeeze in.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I know I should leave, but…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Sorry. Whenever I run with you, it feels like my own future gets dimmer…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …That's right. I'd just spoil everyone else's moods if I hung around. I don't belong in anyone's path.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So is it really all right for me to look forward to a new future with Chiyo? Is it still okay for me to dream, even now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The dreams of many racers fill the air and mingle as the autumn Tenno Sho gets underway.
